scope: Read-only preflight toward a link-only runtime build; no dependencies installed or downloaded; no source patch, link, runtime, emulator, GUI, or game execution.

jgrep.query: configures and links a runtime-only headless executable without graphics or GUI dependencies

plan.configure: Use local CMake and local raylib sources with FetchContent disconnected; PS2X_BUILD_RUNTIME=ON, app targets/recompiler/tests/studio off, PS2X_ENABLE_DEBUG_UI=OFF, PS2X_ENABLE_FFMPEG=OFF.
plan.link: Add all 17 existing Mach-O arm64 generated object files (including registration object) as external objects to ps2EntryRunner, then build/link only; do not launch.
plan.reason_for_objects: Generated archive references PS2Runtime methods while runtime code references generated table globals; direct object inclusion avoids relying on static-archive scan ordering.
plan.claim_limit: Would establish only matched macOS arm64 compile/link compatibility, not game semantics or runnable completeness.
